name: audit
description: Automatically records who — developer or which AI tool — wrote or changed each line, file, and structural change in your project, stored locally as readable markdown.

commands.title: Audit: Add Today's Summary to Commit Message
Audit: Add Reason to Last Entry

audit.developerName.description: Name to attribute manual edits to. Prompted on first run if empty.

audit.logFolder.description: Folder (relative to workspace root) where markdown logs are stored.

audit.minLinesForAIHeuristic.description: Minimum lines inserted in a single edit event before it's considered a possible AI-tool insertion rather than manual typing.

audit.preferredAITool.description: If you only ever use ONE AI tool in this workspace, set its name here (e.g. 'Claude Code') to get exact attribution instead of a 'possibly: X / Y / Z' guess when multiple AI extensions are installed and active. Leave empty for automatic (ambiguous) detection.

audit.excludeDesignChangeForTestFiles.description: Skip the Design-Change flag for .spec./.test. files, where routine import/signature edits are normal boilerplate rather than real architecture changes.

audit.ignoreBlankLineChanges.description: Don't log edits that only add or remove blank/whitespace lines — no real code changed.

audit.ignoreCommentOnlyChanges.description: Don't log edits where every affected line (added and removed) is a comment — no functional code changed.

audit.tagGitBranch.description: Tag each log entry with the current git branch name, when a git repository is open.

audit.protectLogFromExternalChanges.description: Watch the log files for deletion or truncation by any process (including AI agents with file-write access) and automatically restore them from the last known good state.
